description: Contract for one verified public REST endpoint (Illinois, Kentucky, Indiana, or federal backstop) used by the Tri-State Systems Manager data fabric. A base_url is recorded only after a live HTTP 200 verification; unverifiable services are recorded with status 'unverifiable' and never with an invented URL. This registry is operational metadata only and confers no regulatory standing.

authority.description: Owning agency or program, e.g. 'Illinois State Geological Survey'.

base_url.description: Verified service root URL. Must have returned HTTP 200 at verified_at, or be the literal string 'unverifiable' when verification_status is 'unverifiable'.

http_status.description: HTTP status returned by the verification request; null when unverifiable.

layers_or_datasets.description: Layers/datasets of interest observed at the service root.

provenance_label.description: TSM provenance taxonomy label for data served by this endpoint.

target_crs.description: Native/analysis CRS for this authority's data, e.g. 'EPSG:3435' (Illinois East ftUS), 'EPSG:3088' (Kentucky Single Zone), 'EPSG:2966' (Indiana West ftUS). Null when not applicable (e.g. non-spatial data APIs).

verification_evidence.description: How verification was performed, e.g. 'curl -sI <url> returned 200 on 2026-09-26'.

verified_at.description: UTC timestamp of the live verification request.

verify_url.description: Optional full URL (with required query params) used for liveness re-checks when the bare base_url needs parameters to return 200.

title: TSM Tri-State REST Endpoint
